Name: AT x CP - Molamole's Mailbox
Author: MolaMole
Description:
[center][b]| Screenshots feature |
[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37723]Molamole's Island Farm House[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42871]Elle's Cuter Foliage[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37798]Elle's Cuter Grass[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]
- ﻿[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/0jyk0SFj/Mail-Box0001.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Here some Vanilla[b] Farm [/b] +[b] Island Farm [/b]+ [b]Cabin MailBox[/b] textures! -with a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23117]ShippingBin[/url] texture to match and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31974]Cabins[/url]-
With [b]15 Styles[/b] ([i]Wood, Metal and Stone x5[/i]), [b]5 Color[/b] variations ([i]Classic, NonClassic, Light, Medium and Dark[/i]), [b]Tile colors[/b] ([i]Red, Green, Blue, Dark and Non[/i] for the NoWood styles or tiles ) and [b]seasonal[/b] textures for each ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ in [b][AT] & [CP] [/b]format!.
[size=2]New!: There's a [b][Randomness] [/b]option if you wanna wake up with a different MailBox each day (only available for [Farm MailBox] and [Island MailBox] :'D)[/size]

There Are...:
[list]
[*][b][AT] Molamole's Seasonal MailBox: [/b]Seasonal textures + Tile Color variants[/*]
[*][b][AT] Molamole's MaliBox: [/b]NonSeasonal textures + Tile Color variants.[/*]
[*][b][CP] Molamole's MailBox: [/b]All options, + Island Farm & Cabin Mailbox, with a configuration panel.[/*]
[/list][b][s][size=3]
[ Known issues][/size][/s][/b]
If you have an old file -prev 1.6-, can be a conflict with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage - Unofficial Update for 1.6[/url] (Island Mailbox) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21219]Ace's Expanded Farms[/url] (Farm Mailbox). Mole don't know how to fix it _(:3/ V)_ sowyy

[center][size=2][b]
[size=4][b]IMPORTANT: [/b][/size][size=4][b]
You need to have the [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative texture[/url]﻿] Mod -for the [AT] ver.-
[size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] and [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]] Mods [/b][/size]-for the [CP] ver.-
to choose the texture[/b][/size]
-[size=2][b]
[size=2][b][size=2][b]Mole only upload Mods on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/][/url][size=3][size=3][b][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]C[/url][url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]urseForge[/url]﻿﻿![/size][/b][/b][/size][/size],
If you find them in other places, were submit without my knowledge
and I can't guarantee the safety of the file. 
Be careful there![/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size][/center]


[center][i]---------------- [ESP] ----------------
[/i][/center]
[center]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ydvBxdxd/Mail-Box0002.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Aquí algunas texturas para el [b]Buzón[/b] de la granja e[b] Isla[/b] más el buzón de las [b]Cabinas[/b]!
Con [b]15 diseños[/b] ([i]Madera, Metal y Piedra x5[/i]), [b]5 texturas [/b]([i]Classic, NonClassic, Light, Medium y Dark[/i]), y diferentes [b]colores de tejas[/b] ([i]Rojo, verde, Azul , oscuro y Non para los diseños que no son de madera o azulejos[/i]), más [b]variantes estacionales[/b] ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ en formato  [b][AT] & [CP][/b]!
[size=2]Existe la opción[b] [aleatorio][/b] si deseas despertarte con un buzón diferente cada día! (solo disponible para el buzón de la granja e isla :'D)[/size]

Por el momento se dividen en tres versiones:
[list]
[*][b][AT] Molamole's Seasonal MailBox:[/b] Contiene las versiones estacionales + variantes de tejado.[/*]
[*][b][AT] Molamole's MaliBox: [/b]Texturas no estacionales + variantes de tejado.[/*]
[*][b][CP] Molamole's MailBox:[/b] Todas las opciones previas + Isla & Cabinas, acompañado de un panel de configuración. [i](Marca "Non" en la parte de "TileColor" para las versiones de Metal y Piedra)[/i][/*]
[/list]

[b][s][size=3][ Problemas conocidos ][/size][/s][/b]
Si juegas con una granja antigua (previa a 1.6) pueden haber conflictos con los siguientes Mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage - Unofficial Update for 1.6[/url]﻿ (Island Mailbox) y [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21219]Ace's Expanded Farms[/url]﻿ (Farm Mailbox). La topa no es muy lista para arreglarlos _(:3/ V)_
[center]

[size=4][b]IMPORTANTE:
Es necesario tener el Mod [size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative texture[/url]﻿] /[/b][/size]para la versión [AT]
[size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] & [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]] /[/b][/size]para la versión [CP]
